task: A shop exported five invoices, and some of them can't count as sales. Build a small quality tool that reads the file, rejects the broken rows, adds up what's left, and reports the same three numbers in a file and on the command line.

produce.name: quality.py
produce.about: Counts the invoices, splits kept from rejected rows, totals the kept rows and writes the report.

produce.name: main.py
produce.about: The command: prints the kept count, the rejected count and the kept total.

produce.name: quality.txt
produce.about: Kept count, rejected count and kept total, one per line.

steps.P04.m1: Read the sales file and count the invoices.
steps.P04.m2: Reject rows with a blank description, a quantity or a price that isn't positive.
steps.P04.m3: Total quantity times price over the kept rows only.
steps.P04.m4: Write the kept count, rejected count and total to a file.
steps.P04.m5: Print the same three numbers from the command, every run.

problems: One invoice has a blank description.
One invoice has a negative quantity.
One invoice has a price of zero.
The same product is on two invoices, and only one of them can be kept.
